blocks.zh: 設計審查
blocks.en: Design Review

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 Design Review（設計審查）與 Design Qualification（設計確效, DQ）的定義、目的及其在 HVAC 系統生命週期中的角色
blocks.en: Understand the definitions and purpose of Design Review and Design Qualification (DQ), and their role in the HVAC system lifecycle

blocks.zh: 掌握設計審查的七大目標，以及為何在施工前進行審查能大幅降低成本與風險
blocks.en: Master the seven objectives of design review, and why reviewing before construction greatly reduces cost and risk

blocks.zh: 了解 GEP 審查與 GMP 審查的區分邏輯，以及何時需要啟動正式的設計確效（DQ）
blocks.en: Understand the logic for separating GEP review from GMP review, and when a formal Design Qualification (DQ) needs to be launched

blocks.zh: 熟悉 Table 4.1 ~ Table 4.4 四大設計審查 Checklist 的應用場景與關鍵審查項目
blocks.en: Become familiar with the use cases and key review items of the four design review checklists, Table 4.1 to Table 4.4

blocks.zh: 學會如何組建跨功能設計審查團隊，並運用 FMEA 等風險工具強化設計穩健性
blocks.en: Learn how to assemble a cross-functional design review team and use risk tools such as FMEA to strengthen design robustness

blocks.zh: 4.1 Design Review (Design Qualification)（設計審查 / 設計確效）
blocks.en: 4.1 Design Review (Design Qualification)

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：Design Review vs. Design Qualification
blocks.en: Core Concept: Design Review vs. Design Qualification

blocks.zh: Design Review（設計審查）：在設計開發過程中，由跨功能團隊對圖紙與規格進行系統性審查，確保設計符合使用者需求與工程最佳實踐。這是一個持續性的活動，從概念階段一直延續到施工發包。
blocks.en: Design Review: a systematic review of drawings and specifications by a cross-functional team during design development, to ensure the design meets user needs and engineering best practice. It is an ongoing activity that runs from the concept stage through to construction tender.

blocks.zh: Design Qualification（設計確效, DQ）：最終的「品質審查」環節，正式確認設計符合 GMP 法規要求，並宣告設計「適合預定用途（fit for intended use）」。DQ 是 V-Model 確效生命週期的第一步。
blocks.en: Design Qualification (DQ): the final "quality review" step that formally confirms the design meets GMP regulatory requirements and declares the design "fit for intended use". DQ is the first step of the V-Model qualification lifecycle.

blocks.zh: 兩者的關係：Design Review 是較廣泛的工程活動，DQ 是其中專注於 GMP 合規的子集。
blocks.en: How the two relate: Design Review is the broader engineering activity; DQ is the subset of it that focuses on GMP compliance.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：蓋房子前先看藍圖
blocks.en: Analogy: Reading the Blueprint Before Building a House

blocks.zh: 想像你要蓋一棟新房子。在開始打地基之前，你會找建築師、水電師傅、室內設計師一起看藍圖：
blocks.en: Imagine you are building a new house. Before breaking ground, you get the architect, the plumber/electrician and the interior designer to go through the blueprint together:

blocks.zh: 建築師確認結構安全（= 工程審查）
blocks.en: The architect confirms structural safety (= engineering review)

blocks.zh: 消防局確認逃生通道符合法規（= GMP 審查）
blocks.en: The fire department confirms escape routes meet regulations (= GMP review)

blocks.zh: 屋主確認格局符合需求（= URS 比對）
blocks.en: The homeowner confirms the layout meets their needs (= URS comparison)

blocks.zh: 藍圖上改一條線只要幾分鐘，但房子蓋好後要拆牆改管線就要花幾十萬。HVAC 設計審查的邏輯完全一樣——施工前發現問題，成本是施工後的 1/10。
blocks.en: Changing a line on the blueprint takes minutes, but tearing out walls to reroute pipes after the house is built costs a fortune. HVAC design review follows exactly the same logic: a problem found before construction costs about 1/10 of one found afterwards.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：DQ 是法規要求，不是可選項目
blocks.en: Key Point: DQ Is a Regulatory Requirement, Not Optional

blocks.zh: ICH Q7 與歐盟 GMP 明確要求 DQ。許多公司誤以為 DQ 只是「好的工程實踐」，但實際上：
blocks.en: ICH Q7 and EU GMP explicitly require DQ. Many companies mistakenly think DQ is merely "good engineering practice", but in fact:

blocks.zh: EU GMP Annex 15 明確將 DQ 列為驗證的第一步
blocks.en: EU GMP Annex 15 explicitly lists DQ as the first step of validation

blocks.zh: FDA 期望看到「設計符合 GMP 的書面證據」
blocks.en: FDA expects to see documented evidence that the design complies with GMP

blocks.zh: DQ 報告是稽查員審查的第一份確效文件
blocks.en: The DQ report is the first qualification document an inspector reviews

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境中，DQ 更加關鍵——因為 HVAC 系統必須同時滿足多個客戶產品的環境需求。
blocks.en: In a CDMO environment DQ is even more critical, because the HVAC system must meet the environmental needs of several clients' products at the same time.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：設計核准 vs. 設計審查
blocks.en: Key Point: Design Approval vs. Design Review

blocks.zh: 原文特別指出：「Users usually do not approve a design to avoid making design responsibility unclear.」
blocks.en: The source text states specifically: "Users usually do not approve a design to avoid making design responsibility unclear."

blocks.zh: 這是一個重要的法規觀念——使用者審查但不核准設計。設計責任仍屬於設計工程師（engineer of record）。使用者的角色是提出意見與確認需求被滿足，而不是承擔設計責任。這在出問題時的責任歸屬至關重要。
blocks.en: This is an important regulatory concept: users review the design but do not approve it. Design responsibility remains with the design engineer (the engineer of record). The user's role is to give comments and confirm that requirements are met, not to take on design responsibility. This is critical for determining accountability when problems arise.

blocks.zh: 實務應用：CDMO 的設計審查策略
blocks.en: Practical Application: Design Review Strategy for a CDMO

blocks.zh: 對無菌充填 CDMO 而言，HVAC 設計審查必須特別關注：
blocks.en: For an aseptic filling CDMO, HVAC design review must pay particular attention to:

blocks.zh: 多產品彈性：不同客戶產品可能需要不同溫濕度範圍，設計是否預留調整空間？
blocks.en: Multi-product flexibility: different clients' products may need different temperature and humidity ranges. Does the design leave room for adjustment?

blocks.zh: 交叉污染防控：壓差梯度與氣流方向是否能防止產品間交叉污染？
blocks.en: Cross-contamination control: can the pressure differential cascade and airflow direction prevent cross-contamination between products?

blocks.zh: 法規多軌合規：同一設施可能需要同時符合 FDA、EMA、PIC/S 要求
blocks.en: Multi-regulator compliance: the same facility may need to meet FDA, EMA and PIC/S requirements at the same time

blocks.zh: 產能擴張：設計是否為未來新增產線預留 HVAC 容量？
blocks.en: Capacity expansion: does the design reserve HVAC capacity for future production lines?

blocks.zh: 建議在 URS 階段就將這些 CDMO 特有需求明確寫入，避免設計審查時才發現缺口。
blocks.en: We recommend writing these CDMO-specific needs explicitly into the URS, to avoid discovering gaps only at design review.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 一家 CDMO 的 HVAC 設計通過了工程審查，但尚未進行 GMP 審查就開始施工。如果稽查員發現這個情況，可能會提出什麼 observation？
blocks.en: A CDMO's HVAC design passed engineering review, but construction started before any GMP review was done. If an inspector finds this, what observation might they raise?

blocks.zh: 設計確效（DQ）完成後，客戶要求將某間潔淨室從 ISO 8 升級為 ISO 7。這個變更應該走什麼流程？為什麼？
blocks.en: After DQ is complete, a client asks to upgrade a cleanroom from ISO 8 to ISO 7. What process should this change follow, and why?

blocks.zh: 4.1 (cont'd) Knowledge Capture & Review Methods（知識管理與審查方法）
blocks.en: 4.1 (cont'd) Knowledge Capture & Review Methods

blocks.zh: 核心概念：知識管理系統（Knowledge Capture）
blocks.en: Core Concept: Knowledge Capture

blocks.zh: ISPE 在此強調的是組織知識的制度化——不要讓經驗只留在資深工程師的腦袋裡。兩個關鍵工具：
blocks.en: What ISPE emphasizes here is the institutionalization of organizational knowledge: do not let experience stay only in the heads of senior engineers. Two key tools:

blocks.zh: Design Review Checklists：標準化的審查清單，確保每次審查都涵蓋所有關鍵面向（見 Table 4.1~4.4）
blocks.en: Design Review Checklists: standardized review lists that make sure every review covers all key aspects (see Tables 4.1 to 4.4)

blocks.zh: Design Guides：公司內部的設計規範，定義 HVAC 系統的「慣用做法」
blocks.en: Design Guides: in-house design standards that define the "usual practice" for HVAC systems

blocks.zh: 這兩個工具的價值在於：即使資深工程師離職，組織知識仍然被保留。對 CDMO 而言，這更是確保多站點一致性的關鍵。
blocks.en: The value of these two tools is that organizational knowledge is retained even when senior engineers leave. For a CDMO, they are also key to ensuring consistency across sites.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：飛行員的 Checklist
blocks.en: Analogy: The Pilot's Checklist

blocks.zh: 波音 737 起飛前，無論飛行員多資深，都必須逐項完成起飛前檢查清單。這不是因為飛行員不夠專業，而是因為：
blocks.en: Before a Boeing 737 takes off, no matter how experienced the pilots are, they must complete the pre-flight checklist item by item. This is not because pilots are unprofessional, but because:

blocks.zh: 人腦在處理複雜系統時容易遺漏
blocks.en: The human brain easily misses things when handling complex systems

blocks.zh: 清單確保每次都達到同樣的品質標準
blocks.en: A checklist ensures the same quality standard every time

blocks.zh: 這是從歷史事故中提煉出的寶貴教訓
blocks.en: It distills hard lessons learned from past accidents

blocks.zh: HVAC 設計審查清單（Table 4.1~4.4）就是 HVAC 工程師的「起飛前 Checklist」。
blocks.en: The HVAC design review checklists (Tables 4.1 to 4.4) are the HVAC engineer's "pre-flight checklist".

blocks.zh: 重點提示：FMEA 在 HVAC 設計中的應用
blocks.en: Key Point: Applying FMEA in HVAC Design

blocks.zh: 原文提到對高可靠性需求的區域（如動物房 vivarium）可使用 FMEA（失效模式與效應分析）進行正式審查。
blocks.en: The source text notes that areas with high reliability needs (such as a vivarium) can be reviewed formally using FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis).

blocks.zh: 在無菌製造環境中，FMEA 特別適用於以下場景：
blocks.en: In an aseptic manufacturing environment, FMEA is particularly useful in the following scenarios:

blocks.zh: 單一 AHU 故障對相鄰潔淨室壓差的影響
blocks.en: The effect of a single AHU failure on the pressure differential of adjacent cleanrooms

blocks.zh: 冷卻系統失效時的溫度失控風險
blocks.en: The risk of temperature excursion when the cooling system fails

blocks.zh: HEPA 過濾器洩漏對潔淨度的影響
blocks.en: The effect of a HEPA filter leak on cleanliness

blocks.zh: 控制系統故障時的 fail-safe 設計是否足夠
blocks.en: Whether the fail-safe design is adequate when the control system fails

blocks.zh: 即使不做完整 FMEA，至少要考慮「系統失效對產品品質的影響」——這就是原文所說的 simplified version。
blocks.en: Even without a full FMEA, at least consider "the effect of system failure on product quality". This is the simplified version mentioned in the source text.

blocks.zh: 設計審查階段規劃
blocks.en: Design Review Stage Planning

blocks.zh:
大型專案（多系統）：
  概念階段審查 → 中期設計審查 → 最終審查（施工前）
  ├── 概念階段：確認 A&E 公司提案符合使用者需求
  ├── 中期審查：檢視詳細設計，識別風險
  └── 最終審查：確認施工圖完整，發行 DQ

小型專案（單一系統）：
  至少一次設計審查 → 施工前發行
  └── 審查範圍與深度由專案團隊決定
blocks.en:
Large project (multiple systems):
  Concept stage review → Mid-design review → Final review (before construction)
  ├── Concept stage: confirm the A&E firm's proposal meets user needs
  ├── Mid-design review: examine the detailed design and identify risks
  └── Final review: confirm the construction drawings are complete and issue the DQ

Small project (single system):
  At least one design review → issue before construction
  └── Scope and depth of review determined by the project team

blocks.zh: 你的公司沒有 HVAC Design Guide，每次新專案都從頭設計。這可能造成什麼問題？你會如何建立第一版 Design Guide？
blocks.en: Your company has no HVAC Design Guide, so every new project is designed from scratch. What problems might this cause? How would you build the first version of a Design Guide?

blocks.zh: 一位資深 HVAC 工程師即將退休，他 20 年來累積的設計經驗大部分在他腦中。你會用什麼方法在他退休前將這些知識「制度化」？
blocks.en: A senior HVAC engineer is about to retire, and most of his 20 years of design experience is in his head. What method would you use to "institutionalize" this knowledge before he leaves?

blocks.zh: 4.2 Design Review Process（設計審查流程）
blocks.en: 4.2 Design Review Process

blocks.zh: 核心概念：GEP 審查 vs. GMP 審查
blocks.en: Core Concept: GEP Review vs. GMP Review

blocks.zh: 這是本節最重要的架構性概念。ISPE 建議將設計審查分為兩軌：
blocks.en: This is the most important structural concept in this section. ISPE recommends splitting design review into two tracks:

blocks.zh: GEP 審查（Good Engineering Practice）：涵蓋工程最佳實踐、可維護性、可靠性、節能等「做得好」的面向。觀察記錄不需要正式的 audit trail。
blocks.en: GEP review (Good Engineering Practice): covers engineering best practice, maintainability, reliability, energy saving and other "doing it well" aspects. Observations do not need a formal audit trail.

blocks.zh: GMP 審查：聚焦於法規合規——溫濕度、分級、壓差、交叉污染等「必須做到」的面向。每項觀察必須被追蹤並建立 audit trail。
blocks.en: GMP review: focuses on regulatory compliance (temperature and humidity, classification, pressure differentials, cross-contamination and so on), the "must be met" aspects. Every observation must be tracked and given an audit trail.

blocks.zh: 為什麼要分開？因為 GEP 觀察可能有數十甚至數百條（包括大量工程偏好），如果全部混在 GMP audit trail 裡，反而會稀釋真正關鍵的 GMP 合規議題。
blocks.en: Why separate them? GEP observations can number in the dozens or even hundreds (including many engineering preferences). If they were all mixed into the GMP audit trail, they would dilute the GMP compliance issues that really matter.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：餐廳驗收的兩層審查
blocks.en: Analogy: Two Layers of Acceptance for a Restaurant

blocks.zh: 一家新餐廳裝修完畢，驗收分兩個層級：
blocks.en: When a new restaurant finishes fit-out, acceptance happens at two levels:

blocks.zh: 工程驗收（= GEP）：檢查電線是否整齊、水管是否有漏、排煙效果好不好、設備是否方便維修——做得好不好的問題
blocks.en: Engineering acceptance (= GEP): are the wires tidy, do the pipes leak, does the extraction work well, is the equipment easy to repair? These are questions of how well it is done

blocks.zh: 衛生局稽查（= GMP）：檢查廚房溫度控制、食材儲存區域隔離、排水系統是否符合食安法規——合不合規的問題
blocks.en: Health department inspection (= GMP): is kitchen temperature controlled, is the food storage area segregated, does the drainage system meet food safety law? These are questions of compliance

blocks.zh: 工程驗收有很多建議（「這個插座建議換個位置比較好用」），但衛生局稽查只關注法規紅線（「冷藏溫度超標就不發許可」）。分開處理，效率最高。
blocks.en: Engineering acceptance produces many suggestions ("this socket would be more useful in another spot"), but the health department looks only at the regulatory red lines ("if refrigeration temperature is out of range, no permit is issued"). Handling them separately is the most efficient.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：EHS 審查不要忘記
blocks.en: Key Point: Do Not Forget the EHS Review

blocks.zh: 原文順帶提到：「A Health and Safety review also may be justified for facilities handling potent or flammable compounds.」
blocks.en: The source text mentions in passing: "A Health and Safety review also may be justified for facilities handling potent or flammable compounds."

blocks.zh: 這在 CDMO 環境中特別重要，因為：
blocks.en: This is especially important in a CDMO environment, because:

blocks.zh: 高效價藥物（high potency compounds）需要負壓控制與專用排氣
blocks.en: High-potency compounds need negative pressure control and dedicated exhaust

blocks.zh: 易燃溶劑操作需要防爆設計（ATEX 分區）
blocks.en: Handling flammable solvents requires explosion-proof design (ATEX zoning)

blocks.zh: 生物製劑可能涉及生物安全等級（BSL）要求
blocks.en: Biologics may involve biosafety level (BSL) requirements

blocks.zh: HVAC 設計審查時，務必確認是否需要額外的 EHS 審查，否則施工後補救代價極高。
blocks.en: During HVAC design review, always confirm whether an additional EHS review is needed; otherwise fixing it after construction is extremely costly.

blocks.zh: 在 GEP 審查中，你發現設計工程師將 AHU 維護空間壓縮到僅 40 公分寬。這不違反任何 GMP 法規，但你認為會造成維護困難。你會如何在審查中記錄這個觀察？需要 audit trail 嗎？
blocks.en: In a GEP review, you find the design engineer has squeezed AHU maintenance space to only 40 cm wide. This violates no GMP regulation, but you believe it will make maintenance difficult. How would you record this observation in the review? Is an audit trail needed?

blocks.zh: 一項 GMP 審查發現：設計圖上 B 級潔淨室與 C 級走廊之間的壓差設計為 10 Pa，低於建議的 15 Pa。你會如何處理？
blocks.en: A GMP review finds that the drawings show a pressure differential of 10 Pa between a grade B cleanroom and a grade C corridor, lower than the recommended 15 Pa. How would you handle it?

blocks.zh: Table 4.1: Typical Design Concept Stage GMP Review（概念階段 GMP 審查）
blocks.en: Table 4.1: Typical Design Concept Stage GMP Review

blocks.zh: 核心概念：概念階段的「大方向」審查
blocks.en: Core Concept: A "Big Picture" Review at the Concept Stage

blocks.zh: Table 4.1 是在設計最早期（概念階段）使用的 Checklist。此時重點不在細節，而在大方向是否正確：
blocks.en: Table 4.1 is the checklist used at the earliest design stage (concept stage). The focus here is not on details but on whether the big direction is right:

blocks.zh: 關鍵參數是否定義？——如果連溫度、濕度、壓差的設計目標都沒有定義，後面的設計都是白做
blocks.en: Are the critical parameters defined? If not even the design targets for temperature, humidity and pressure differential are defined, all later design work is wasted

blocks.zh: 區域劃分是否合理？——AHU 分區必須基於製程需求，而非建築便利
blocks.en: Is the zoning reasonable? AHU zoning must be based on process needs, not building convenience

blocks.zh: 氣流方向是否正確？——空氣永遠從潔淨區流向較不潔淨區，這是最基本的 GMP 原則
blocks.en: Is the airflow direction correct? Air always flows from the cleaner area to the less clean area; this is the most basic GMP principle

blocks.zh: 重點提示：風險評估（Risk Assessment）是 DQ 的基礎
blocks.en: Key Point: Risk Assessment Is the Foundation of DQ

blocks.zh: 第一個 Design Challenge 就問：「關鍵參數的選定理由（風險評估）是否有文件記錄？」
blocks.en: The first Design Challenge asks: "Is the rationale for selecting the critical parameters (risk assessment) documented?"

blocks.zh: 這揭示了一個關鍵邏輯：DQ 的起點不是設計本身，而是風險評估。你必須先透過 Risk Assessment 識別哪些參數是「關鍵的」，然後才能審查設計是否滿足這些關鍵參數。
blocks.en: This reveals a key logic: the starting point of DQ is not the design itself but the risk assessment. You must first use risk assessment to identify which parameters are "critical", and only then can you review whether the design meets them.

blocks.zh: 沒有 Risk Assessment 支撐的 DQ，在稽查時會被視為「沒有科學依據的表面功夫」。
blocks.en: A DQ without risk assessment behind it will be seen at inspection as "window dressing with no scientific basis".

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：蓋學校前先確認學區規劃
blocks.en: Analogy: Confirming School District Planning Before Building a School

blocks.zh: 概念階段審查就像蓋學校前，先確認：
blocks.en: Concept stage review is like confirming the following before building a school:

blocks.zh: 這個學區要服務多少學生？（= 製程需求決定 AHU 分區）
blocks.en: How many students will this district serve? (= process needs determine AHU zoning)

blocks.zh: 教室要不要空調？圖書館要不要獨立溫控？（= 溫濕度需求定義）
blocks.en: Do the classrooms need air conditioning? Does the library need independent temperature control? (= defining temperature and humidity requirements)

blocks.zh: 消防通道方向對不對？（= 氣流方向 / 壓差方向）
blocks.en: Are the fire escape routes pointing the right way? (= airflow direction / pressure differential direction)

blocks.zh: 如果這些大方向搞錯了，等校舍蓋好才發現，改建成本可能是原始建設成本的 30~50%。
blocks.en: If these big decisions are wrong and only discovered after the school is built, the cost of rebuilding can reach 30 to 50% of the original construction cost.

blocks.zh: 你正在審查一個新廠的 HVAC 概念設計。設計圖顯示所有製造區域共用一台大型 AHU。從 GMP 角度，你會提出什麼疑慮？
blocks.en: You are reviewing the HVAC concept design for a new plant. The drawings show a single large AHU serving all manufacturing areas. From a GMP perspective, what concerns would you raise?

blocks.zh: 設計書上寫著「溫度範圍 18-25°C」但沒有定義哪些區域需要更嚴格的控制。這在概念階段審查中應該如何處理？
blocks.en: The design document says "temperature range 18-25°C" but does not define which areas need tighter control. How should this be handled in a concept stage review?

blocks.zh: Table 4.2: Detail Design or Issue for Construction Stage GMP Review（詳細設計 / 施工階段 GMP 審查）
blocks.en: Table 4.2: Detail Design or Issue for Construction Stage GMP Review

blocks.zh: 核心概念：詳細設計審查的全面性
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Comprehensiveness of Detailed Design Review

blocks.zh: Table 4.2 是整個設計審查中最長、最詳盡的 Checklist，涵蓋了 HVAC 系統從外部條件到內部細節的所有 GMP 相關面向。可以將其分為幾個主題群組：
blocks.en: Table 4.2 is the longest and most detailed checklist in the whole design review, covering every GMP-relevant aspect of an HVAC system from external conditions to internal details. It can be divided into several thematic groups:

blocks.zh: 外部環境：氣象條件、進排氣口位置、盛行風向
blocks.en: External environment: weather conditions, locations of air intakes and exhausts, prevailing wind direction

blocks.zh: 內部環境：溫度、濕度、壓差、分級、感測器位置
blocks.en: Internal environment: temperature, humidity, pressure differential, classification, sensor locations

blocks.zh: 空氣處理：AHU 設計、過濾器規格、風管材質
blocks.en: Air handling: AHU design, filter specifications, ductwork material

blocks.zh: 監控與報警：紀錄系統、報警限值、控制安全
blocks.en: Monitoring and alarms: recording systems, alarm limits, control security

blocks.zh: 失效模式：斷電、AHU 故障、交叉污染風險
blocks.en: Failure modes: power loss, AHU failure, cross-contamination risk

blocks.zh: 重點提示：關鍵數字必須記住
blocks.en: Key Point: Know the Key Numbers

blocks.zh: Table 4.2 中包含幾個極為重要的設計數據：
blocks.en: Table 4.2 contains several extremely important design figures:

blocks.zh: 15 Pa：不同潔淨等級之間 Airlock 的最低設計壓差
blocks.en: 15 Pa: the minimum design pressure differential for airlocks between different cleanliness grades

blocks.zh: 20 Pa：建議的設計壓差（預留施工誤差的裕度）
blocks.en: 20 Pa: the recommended design pressure differential (leaving a margin for construction tolerance)

blocks.zh: 99.97%（H13/H14）：分級區域的 HEPA 過濾器效率要求
blocks.en: 99.97% (H13/H14): the required HEPA filter efficiency for classified areas

blocks.zh: 4 feet（約 1.2 m）：非分級區域軟管最大允許長度；分級區域禁止使用軟管
blocks.en: 4 feet (about 1.2 m): the maximum permitted length of flexible hose in non-classified areas; flexible hose is prohibited in classified areas

blocks.zh: 這些數字在稽查中經常被問到，必須能夠立即回答並引用出處。
blocks.en: These numbers are often asked about during inspections, so you must be able to answer immediately and cite the source.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：感測器位置的代表性
blocks.en: Key Point: Representativeness of Sensor Locations

blocks.zh: 原文對 monitoring sensor 位置的論述非常詳細，值得特別關注：
blocks.en: The source text discusses monitoring sensor locations in great detail, which deserves special attention:

blocks.zh: 大空間（如倉庫）需要多點 mapping 與監控
blocks.en: Large spaces (such as warehouses) need multi-point mapping and monitoring

blocks.zh: 小空間 1-2 個監測點通常足夠，但需在確效時證明其代表性
blocks.en: In small spaces 1-2 monitoring points are usually enough, but their representativeness must be demonstrated during qualification

blocks.zh: 感測器位置要考慮「產品暴露在哪裡」——例如充填區的感測器應該靠近產品暴露點
blocks.en: Sensor location must consider "where the product is exposed"; for example, sensors in a filling area should be close to the point of product exposure

blocks.zh: 感測器必須方便維護與校準
blocks.en: Sensors must be easy to maintain and calibrate

blocks.zh: 感測器位置不當是 FDA 483 常見的觀察項目之一。
blocks.en: Poor sensor placement is one of the commonly cited FDA 483 observations.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：溫度計放在冰箱門邊 vs. 食物旁
blocks.en: Analogy: A Thermometer at the Fridge Door vs. Next to the Food

blocks.zh: 家裡冰箱如果把溫度計放在門邊（每次開門溫度波動最大的地方），量到的溫度就不能代表食物儲存區的真實溫度。
blocks.en: If you put a thermometer at the door of your home fridge (where temperature fluctuates most every time it is opened), the reading cannot represent the true temperature of the food storage area.

blocks.zh: 潔淨室的感測器也一樣——如果放在天花板回風口旁，量到的數值反映的是回風溫度，不是操作人員身旁產品暴露點的溫度。感測器位置的「代表性」是審查中的關鍵質疑點。
blocks.en: Cleanroom sensors are the same: if one is placed next to a ceiling return air grille, its reading reflects return air temperature, not the temperature at the product exposure point beside the operator. The "representativeness" of sensor location is a key point of challenge in review.

blocks.zh: 實務應用：CDMO 的 Table 4.2 審查要點
blocks.en: Practical Application: Key Review Points of Table 4.2 for a CDMO

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，Table 4.2 中有幾個問題特別需要深入審查：
blocks.en: For a CDMO, several questions in Table 4.2 deserve particularly deep review:

blocks.zh: Availability requirements（可用性需求）：不同客戶產品可能有不同的生產排程需求，HVAC 的設計外部條件百分比（如 99.6% availability = ASHRAE 0.4% design conditions）直接影響設備選型與成本
blocks.en: Availability requirements: different clients' products may have different production scheduling needs, and the HVAC design external condition percentage (for example 99.6% availability = ASHRAE 0.4% design conditions) directly affects equipment selection and cost

blocks.zh: Multiple AHU failure modes：CDMO 通常有多條產線同時運作，一台 AHU 故障是否會影響其他產線的壓差級聯？
blocks.en: Multiple AHU failure modes: a CDMO usually runs several lines at once. Would one AHU failure affect the pressure cascade of other lines?

blocks.zh: Containment provisions：如果某個客戶的產品是高效價藥物，排氣過濾設計必須升級
blocks.en: Containment provisions: if a client's product is a high-potency compound, the exhaust filtration design must be upgraded

blocks.zh: 21 CFR 173.310 steam additives：蒸氣加濕器的水質問題在 FDA 稽查中常被關注
blocks.en: 21 CFR 173.310 steam additives: the water quality of steam humidifiers is often a focus in FDA inspections

blocks.zh: 你的工廠位於台灣中南部，夏季高溫多濕。設計工程師使用台北的氣象數據作為外部設計條件。這會造成什麼問題？你會如何修正？
blocks.en: Your plant is in central-southern Taiwan, with hot and humid summers. The design engineer used Taipei weather data as the external design conditions. What problems would this cause, and how would you correct it?

blocks.zh: 設計圖上所有 Airlock 的壓差設計為 15 Pa。考慮到施工後可能的偏差，你會建議修改嗎？為什麼 ISPE 建議 20 Pa？
blocks.en: The design drawings set the pressure differential for all airlocks at 15 Pa. Considering possible deviations after construction, would you suggest changing it? Why does ISPE recommend 20 Pa?

blocks.zh: 一條新的無菌充填線，設計中沒有提到 AHU 故障時的 fail-safe 機制。你會在設計審查中提出什麼建議？
blocks.en: A new aseptic filling line has no mention of a fail-safe mechanism for AHU failure in the design. What would you recommend in the design review?

blocks.zh: Table 4.3: GEP Design Review High Level Challenges（GEP 設計審查高層級挑戰）
blocks.en: Table 4.3: GEP Design Review High Level Challenges

blocks.zh: 核心概念：GEP 審查的「戰略性」問題
blocks.en: Core Concept: The "Strategic" Questions of GEP Review

blocks.zh: 相較於 Table 4.2 那樣的詳細 Checklist，Table 4.3 只有 5 個問題，但每一個都是高層級的戰略性問題。這些問題不是問「有沒有做到某個規格」，而是問「設計的整體思維是否正確」：
blocks.en: Compared with a detailed checklist like Table 4.2, Table 4.3 has only 5 questions, but each is a high-level strategic question. They do not ask "is a given specification met" but "is the overall thinking behind the design right":

blocks.zh: Reliability：系統能否長期穩定運行？
blocks.en: Reliability: can the system run stably over the long term?

blocks.zh: Best practices：是否採用了當前業界最佳做法？
blocks.en: Best practices: does it use current industry best practice?

blocks.zh: Maintainability：日常維護是否方便？校準是否可行？
blocks.en: Maintainability: is routine maintenance convenient? Is calibration feasible?

blocks.zh: Failure modes：系統故障時會發生什麼？設計是否考慮了 fail-safe？
blocks.en: Failure modes: what happens when the system fails? Does the design consider fail-safe?

blocks.zh: Cleanability：天花板回風腔體（ceiling plenum）如何清潔？
blocks.en: Cleanability: how is the ceiling plenum cleaned?

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：買車的五大核心問題
blocks.en: Analogy: Five Core Questions When Buying a Car

blocks.zh: Table 4.3 就像你買車前問的五個根本問題：
blocks.en: Table 4.3 is like the five fundamental questions you ask before buying a car:

blocks.zh: 這車耐不耐用？（= reliability）
blocks.en: Is this car durable? (= reliability)

blocks.zh: 是不是最新款的安全配備？（= current best practices）
blocks.en: Does it have the latest safety features? (= current best practices)

blocks.zh: 保養方不方便？維修費貴不貴？（= maintenance/calibration）
blocks.en: Is servicing convenient? Are repairs expensive? (= maintenance/calibration)

blocks.zh: 爆胎或電池沒電時怎麼辦？（= failure modes）
blocks.en: What if a tyre blows or the battery dies? (= failure modes)

blocks.zh: 座椅套好不好洗？（= cleanability of ceiling plenum）
blocks.en: Are the seat covers easy to wash? (= cleanability of ceiling plenum)

blocks.zh: 這些是「買車決策」層級的問題，不是「這顆螺絲要不要鍍鉻」的細節問題。
blocks.en: These are "car buying decision" level questions, not detail questions like "should this screw be chrome plated".

blocks.zh: 重點提示：Ceiling Plenum Return 的清潔問題
blocks.en: Key Point: Cleaning the Ceiling Plenum Return

blocks.zh: 最後一個 Design Challenge 特別值得關注：「Are ceiling plenum returns proposed; if so, how would the ceiling void be cleaned?」
blocks.en: The last Design Challenge deserves particular attention: "Are ceiling plenum returns proposed; if so, how would the ceiling void be cleaned?"

blocks.zh: 許多工廠為了簡化設計，採用天花板上方空間（ceiling plenum）作為回風通道。但這帶來嚴重的清潔問題：
blocks.en: To simplify the design, many plants use the space above the ceiling (ceiling plenum) as the return air path. But this raises serious cleaning problems:

blocks.zh: 天花板上方空間難以目視檢查
blocks.en: The space above the ceiling is hard to inspect visually

blocks.zh: 灰塵、微粒會在此處累積
blocks.en: Dust and particles accumulate there

blocks.zh: 在分級區域，如果 ceiling plenum 無法有效清潔，可能導致微粒從縫隙掉入潔淨室
blocks.en: In classified areas, if the ceiling plenum cannot be cleaned effectively, particles may fall into the cleanroom through gaps

blocks.zh: GEP 的觀點是：如果清潔不可行，就不應該採用這種設計，即使它更省錢。
blocks.en: The GEP view is: if cleaning is not feasible, this design should not be adopted, even if it is cheaper.

blocks.zh: 你的設計團隊提出使用 ceiling plenum return 以降低建設成本。品質部門提出清潔疑慮。作為專案經理，你會如何評估這個 trade-off？
blocks.en: Your design team proposes a ceiling plenum return to reduce construction cost. The quality department raises cleaning concerns. As project manager, how would you evaluate this trade-off?

blocks.zh: Table 4.3 問「Does the design proposed demonstrate current best practices?」——你會用什麼標準來定義 HVAC 的「current best practices」？你會參考哪些指引或標準？
blocks.en: Table 4.3 asks "Does the design proposed demonstrate current best practices?" What standard would you use to define "current best practices" for HVAC? Which guidelines or standards would you refer to?

blocks.zh: Table 4.4: Detail Design or Issue for Construction Stage GEP Review（詳細設計 / 施工階段 GEP 審查）
blocks.en: Table 4.4: Detail Design or Issue for Construction Stage GEP Review

blocks.zh: 核心概念：GEP 審查的「操作導向」視角
blocks.en: Core Concept: The "Operations-Oriented" View of GEP Review

blocks.zh: Table 4.4 與 Table 4.2 有許多重疊的審查項目（如感測器位置、風管材質、斷電處理），但審查的出發點不同：
blocks.en: Table 4.4 and Table 4.2 share many review items (such as sensor locations, ductwork material and power failure handling), but their starting points differ:

blocks.zh: Table 4.2 (GMP)：「這個設計是否符合法規要求？」
blocks.en: Table 4.2 (GMP): "Does this design meet regulatory requirements?"

blocks.zh: Table 4.4 (GEP)：「這個設計是否方便操作、維護、並能長期可靠運行？」
blocks.en: Table 4.4 (GEP): "Is this design easy to operate and maintain, and can it run reliably over the long term?"

blocks.zh: GEP 審查關注的是系統的長期可持續性——一個技術上合規但維護困難的系統，最終會因為維護不良而變得不合規。
blocks.en: GEP review looks at the system's long-term sustainability: a system that is technically compliant but hard to maintain will eventually become non-compliant through poor maintenance.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：合法但不好用的廚房
blocks.en: Analogy: A Legal but Hard-to-Use Kitchen

blocks.zh: 一個通過衛生局稽查的廚房（GMP 合規），如果：
blocks.en: Take a kitchen that passed the health department inspection (GMP compliant), but where:

blocks.zh: 清洗區的水龍頭太矮，廚師長期彎腰導致背痛
blocks.en: The sink faucet in the wash area is too low, so the chef gets back pain from bending over for long periods

blocks.zh: 冰箱放在狹窄角落，搬食材很不方便
blocks.en: The refrigerator sits in a cramped corner, making it hard to move ingredients

blocks.zh: 排煙管道沒有清潔口，日積月累油垢堵塞
blocks.en: The exhaust duct has no cleaning access, so grease builds up and blocks it over time

blocks.zh: 這些都不違法，但會讓廚房運作效率低下。GEP 審查就是在抓這些「合規但不好用」的設計盲點。
blocks.en: None of this is illegal, but it makes the kitchen run inefficiently. GEP review is there to catch these "compliant but hard to use" design blind spots.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：Building Sickness Syndrome
blocks.en: Key Point: Building Sickness Syndrome

blocks.zh: Table 4.4 提到的 Building Sickness Syndrome（病態建築症候群） 是一個常被忽略但越來越受重視的議題：
blocks.en: Building Sickness Syndrome, mentioned in Table 4.4, is an often overlooked but increasingly important topic:

blocks.zh: HVAC 系統設計不當可能導致工作人員頭痛、疲勞、過敏等症狀
blocks.en: Poor HVAC design can cause headaches, fatigue, allergies and other symptoms in staff

blocks.zh: 常見原因：新鮮空氣比例不足、回風過濾不良、冷凝水排放不當導致微生物生長
blocks.en: Common causes: insufficient fresh air proportion, poor return air filtration, and improper condensate drainage leading to microbial growth

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，操作人員的健康直接影響操作品質和人員流動率
blocks.en: For a CDMO, operator health directly affects operating quality and staff turnover

blocks.zh: GEP 審查不只看設備，也看人——系統對操作人員的友善程度。
blocks.en: GEP review looks not only at equipment but also at people: how friendly the system is to operators.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：未來擴展性（Future-Proofing）
blocks.en: Key Point: Future-Proofing

blocks.zh: Table 4.4 有一個獨特的問題：「How does the design allow for future changes in the room layout in terms of sensor locations and zoning?」
blocks.en: Table 4.4 has a unique question: "How does the design allow for future changes in the room layout in terms of sensor locations and zoning?"

blocks.zh: 這個問題在 GMP Checklist 中不會出現，但對 CDMO 極其重要：
blocks.en: This question would not appear in a GMP checklist, but it is extremely important for a CDMO:

blocks.zh: 客戶組合會變化，製程需求可能改變
blocks.en: The client mix will change, and process needs may change

blocks.zh: 未來可能需要重新分區或增加監控點
blocks.en: Rezoning or additional monitoring points may be needed in future

blocks.zh: 設計時如果沒有預留彈性，每次變更都需要大規模改造
blocks.en: If flexibility is not built in at design, every change will require major rework

blocks.zh: 好的 GEP 設計不只解決今天的問題，更為明天的變化留出空間。
blocks.en: A good GEP design solves not only today's problems but also leaves room for tomorrow's changes.

blocks.zh: 實務應用：GEP vs GMP 審查的實際操作
blocks.en: Practical Application: GEP vs. GMP Review in Practice

blocks.zh: 在實務中，建議的操作方式：
blocks.en: In practice, the recommended approach is:

blocks.zh: GEP 審查：由 HVAC 工程師主導，邀請廠務維護團隊參與。以工作坊形式進行，記錄在工程文件中，不需要正式的 CAPA 追蹤
blocks.en: GEP review: led by HVAC engineers, with the facility maintenance team invited. Held as a workshop, recorded in engineering documents, with no formal CAPA tracking needed

blocks.zh: GMP 審查：由 QA 主導，邀請 HVAC SME 與製程工程師參與。每項觀察都需要在 DQ 報告中追蹤至結案
blocks.en: GMP review: led by QA, with the HVAC SME and process engineers invited. Every observation must be tracked to closure in the DQ report

blocks.zh: 分開進行：避免 GEP 的大量工程建議淹沒 GMP 的關鍵法規議題
blocks.en: Run them separately: to prevent the many GEP engineering suggestions from swamping the key GMP regulatory issues

blocks.zh: 比較 Table 4.2 和 Table 4.4 中關於「感測器位置」的審查問題。兩者的審查出發點有何不同？你會如何分別記錄 GMP 和 GEP 審查中的觀察？
blocks.en: Compare the review questions on "sensor location" in Table 4.2 and Table 4.4. How do their starting points differ? How would you record the observations of the GMP and GEP reviews separately?

blocks.zh: 你的工廠有 10 年歷史，當初沒有做 GEP 審查。現在要進行 HVAC 系統升級，你會建議加入哪些 GEP 審查項目來彌補原始設計的不足？
blocks.en: Your plant is 10 years old and no GEP review was done originally. You are now upgrading the HVAC system. Which GEP review items would you suggest adding to make up for the shortfalls of the original design?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: Design Review（設計審查）是確保 HVAC 設計在施工前符合使用者需求的系統性審查流程；Design Qualification（DQ, 設計確效）是其中專注於 GMP 合規的正式環節，為法規所要求
blocks.en: Design Review is the systematic review process that ensures the HVAC design meets user needs before construction; Design Qualification (DQ) is the formal step within it that focuses on GMP compliance, and is required by regulation

blocks.zh: 設計審查應分為 GEP 審查（工程最佳實踐，不需正式 audit trail）和 GMP 審查（法規合規，需要 audit trail），以避免混淆關鍵議題
blocks.en: Design review should be split into GEP review (engineering best practice, no formal audit trail needed) and GMP review (regulatory compliance, audit trail required), to avoid obscuring key issues

blocks.zh: Table 4.1（概念階段 GMP）聚焦大方向：關鍵參數定義、AHU 分區合理性、氣流方向正確性
blocks.en: Table 4.1 (concept stage GMP) focuses on the big picture: definition of critical parameters, reasonableness of AHU zoning, correctness of airflow direction

blocks.zh: Table 4.2（詳細設計 GMP）是最完整的 Checklist，涵蓋環境設計、監控、過濾、失效模式等所有 GMP 面向。關鍵數字：壓差至少 15 Pa（建議 20 Pa）、HEPA 效率 99.97%（H13/H14）
blocks.en: Table 4.2 (detail design GMP) is the most complete checklist, covering all GMP aspects including environmental design, monitoring, filtration and failure modes. Key numbers: pressure differential at least 15 Pa (20 Pa recommended), HEPA efficiency 99.97% (H13/H14)

blocks.zh: Table 4.3（GEP 高層級）以 5 個戰略性問題審查設計的可靠性、先進性與可維護性
blocks.en: Table 4.3 (GEP high level) uses 5 strategic questions to review the design's reliability, currency of practice and maintainability

blocks.zh: Table 4.4（GEP 詳細）關注操作面的長期可持續性，包括清潔性、未來擴展性、人員健康（病態建築症候群）
blocks.en: Table 4.4 (GEP detail) looks at the long-term sustainability of operations, including cleanability, future expansion and staff health (Building Sickness Syndrome)

blocks.zh: 設計審查團隊應為跨功能團隊（HVAC SME、控制工程師、試車人員、法規專家），高風險區域可運用 FMEA 強化設計穩健性
blocks.en: The design review team should be cross-functional (HVAC SME, controls engineer, commissioning staff, regulatory expert), and for high-risk areas FMEA can be used to strengthen design robustness

blocks.zh: DQ 完成後必須啟動正式變更管控（Change Control），確保後續任何設計變更都經過審查
blocks.en: After DQ is complete, formal Change Control must be initiated to ensure any later design change is reviewed
